text.en: Let us read: as each animal or bird joins, one more is eating the mango, up to nine (pp.18-19)
text.hi: आओ पढ़ें: हर जानवर या पक्षी के आने पर आम खाने वाला एक और बढ़ता है, नौ तक (पृ. 18-19)

text.en: What is one more than one, one more than two, up to nine? (p.19)
text.hi: एक से एक ज़्यादा, दो से एक ज़्यादा, नौ तक कितना होता है? (पृ. 19)

text.en: Tick for more, less or equal; tick the one which is more or less in number (pp.23-24)
text.hi: ज़्यादा, कम या बराबर पर निशान लगाओ; जो संख्या में ज़्यादा या कम है उस पर निशान लगाओ (पृ. 23-24)

text.en: Numbers one, two, three, go: write each number from one to nine (pp.25-27)
text.hi: संख्याएँ एक, दो, तीन: एक से नौ तक हर संख्या लिखो (पृ. 25-27)

text.en: Join the numbers in order; write them from the smallest to the largest (pp.29-30)
text.hi: संख्याओं को क्रम से जोड़ो; उन्हें सबसे छोटी से सबसे बड़ी तक लिखो (पृ. 29-30)

sources.ref: NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics, Ch 3 Mango Treat (textbook pp.18-32), as read in the official NCERT CIET audiobook of the textbook

notes: Class 1 has no separate syllabus document: the textbook is the syllabus. Each line is a section prompt of Chapter 3 as read in the official audiobook, with the textbook page. Only Chapter 3 (Mango Treat) is mapped so far; chapters 1, 2 and 4 to 13 are not yet in the graph. The textbook is NCERT Class 1 Joyful Mathematics. Its file code is aejm1 (chapter 3: aejm103), inferred from NCERT's file naming; ncert.nic.in failed TLS verification through the proxy on 2026-10-31, so the code and the printed pages could not be checked against the PDF. Facts come from the official CIET audiobook, which reads the textbook page by page; the audio was transcribed for this work and the transcript is kept outside the repo.
